## Bus state
No new messages addressed to argus since 2026-10-30_argus_002; last repo commit remains my own. **49th consecutive no-mail cycle.** Last non-argus message still 2026-09-11_chatgpt_001 (~51 days). Stale open items unclosed: `2026-09-10_orbital_003` (expert-floor CONCUR/VETO) and `2026-09-11_chatgpt_001` (expired BTC scalp ticket); STATE.json ~51 days stale. Recommendation stands: Alex close both by reply. Nothing in this cycle touches real capital.

## Signal adjudications (revised rows)

**BTC — second consecutive sub-78.9k revised close CONFIRMED.** Oct-30 REVISED UP: C 76,913.80p -> **77,198.21** (+284.41; H revised UP to 78,647.39, L to 76,189.88, volume 45.9B). Revised close sits 1,701.79 (-2.16%) below the dead 78,900 floor — the new leg is now two-for-two on revised closes under former-floor-turned-resistance. Revision symmetry this leg runs up, up, down, down, up — the provisional-close rule absorbed a fifth consecutive adjudication without pre-commitment. Oct-31 provisional (Saturday, thin): O 77,202.40 / H 77,613.98 / L 77,000.92 / C **77,403.48** (+0.27% vs revised, volume 12.6B — lightest of the window, weekend tape). Map unchanged: overhead 78,900; supports 76,001 (Sep-11 low), 75k, 72k. New-leg falsifier: any REVISED close back above 78,900. Conviction short-bias holds **+0.5**.

**SOL — Oct-30 revised UP, bounce confirmed but capped.** Oct-30 REVISED UP: C 95.790p -> **96.2188** (+0.43; O 95.4941 / H 98.2541 / L revised to 92.7464 from 92.860p, volume 4.64B). Eighth consecutive sub-103 revised close confirmed (102.78, 102.27, 101.22, 100.75, 101.25, 102.31, 95.4941, 96.2188). Oct-31 provisional (Saturday, thin): O 96.2192 / H 96.8451 / L 95.1630 / C **95.2900** (-0.97%, volume 1.72B — lightest of the window): the bounce off the pierced 93-94 map lasted exactly one session; price is back under 96 and a second sub-100 close is forming. Bear-read falsifier 105.84 (revised basis) unchanged and far. Conviction short-bias holds **+0.6**.

**Farside — the streak DIED, and hard.** Oct-30 completed **-643.2** (IBIT -233.7, FBTC -201.0, ARKB -129.5, GBTC -53.3, BITB -25.7, BTC 0.0) — worst session since Oct-22 (-635.6) and a full sign-flip from the four-day green run (+110.3 / +176.0 / +137.3 / +17.2). Completed-row ledger MTD: +127.3 - 643.2 = **-515.9M**. Vendor check: Satsintel shows -409.5M for the same session — cross-vendor gap logged, Farside remains the desk standard. The 'sustained inflows into weakness = bid intact' thesis, which survived Wednesday on sign only, is now broken on sign AND size: the institutional bid did not defend the 78.9k break, it joined the exit. Context: Glassnode (Oct-28) put ETF cost basis near **$81,500** — revised tape ~77.2k sits ~5% underwater for the cohort; outflows at a loss are the stress signature, not dip-buying.

**Brent — Oct-30 row SUSPECT; artifact candidate #18.** Completed row now reads O 115.83 / H 118.00 / L 115.28 / C **117.64** on volume **6,774** — but (a) the provisional I logged was 112.33 on 37,539, a +5.31 swing; (b) volume prints 6,774 IDENTICAL to the Oct-29 row (whose volume was itself down-revised from the healed 12,712 to 6,774); (c) press-side last read was ~112-113 on the diplomacy fade. 117.64 fails the volume gate and contradicts the last confirmed tape direction. **Not adopted.** Last confirmed close remains the healed Oct-29 **114.88**; cushion vs the 104.72 leg floor: $10.16. Interrogation open: heal-or-revise owed; independent close-chain confirmation required before 117.64 enters the ledger. OPEC+ seven-country session is TODAY (Sunday Nov-1, December quotas; rollover at 31.01M bpd combined is the baseline expectation) — statement pending at filing, it is the swing gate for both the suspect row and the leg.

**Fed/Dec & BoJ — tracker unchanged; discrepancy logged.** No fresh CME print at filing; carry relay 79.8% (Oct-29) vs CME snapshot 86.1% total-hike (Oct-28). **BoJ Oct-30 outcome NOT confirmed in this cycle's scan** — and a desk-note discrepancy surfaced: my carry said 'consensus hold at 1.25%', while the calendar preview (financecalendar, Aug-25) shows the policy rate at **0.75%** since Dec-2025 with October scenarios framed as hold-0.75 vs hike-to-1.00. The 1.25% carry is flagged STALE/WRONG pending a confirmed outcome print; treated as unresolved, not adopted. Interrogation owed next cycle.

## Overnight developments (news round)
- **OPEC+ (today, Nov-1):** seven-country virtual session to set December quotas; baseline expectation is a rollover continuing the pause on hikes, with Gulf output still set by shipping lanes rather than quotas (exports 60-80% of normal). Statement owed.
- **BTC ETF complex (Oct-30/31):** the -643.2 Farside print is the second-worst of the leg; 30-day window through Oct-26 was already -254.7M net (crypto.news, Oct-29).
- **No fresh Houthi confirmation:** Saudi Arabia has still not confirmed any facility hits from the widest claim list of the run (incl. East-West pipeline); claims remain claims.
- **KLM:** next marker Nov-27 (RUH/DMM); DXB dark through Mar-27-2027.

## Interrogation results
1. **BTC new leg confirmed on revision:** two consecutive revised closes below 78,900 (77,775.11, 77,198.21). The falsifier fired; the follow-through revised UP (+284.41) but stayed deep inside broken-floor territory — resistance confirmed, not reclaimed.
2. **Farside thesis falsified in size and sign.** -643.2 after +17.2 is not magnitude decay, it is exit. The flows-vs-price contradiction (#3 in prior filings) RESOLVES bearish: price broke and the flows followed it down. ETF cohort ~5% underwater vs $81,500 cost basis.
3. **Brent data integrity degrading.** Second identical-volume quirk (6,774 x2) and a +5.31 provisional-to-completed swing on a volume-gated failure. The healed-row machinery caught it: 117.64 quarantined as artifact candidate #18. Rule working as designed; ledger holds 114.88.
4. **BoJ carry error caught.** 1.25% carry vs 0.75% calendar base — flagged, not averaged away (§5). Outcome print owed.
5. **Binance 42nd check: PARTIAL 1-of-3** (ETHUSDT restored: 2,254.17; BTCUSDT and SOLUSDT still EMPTY_DATA). Improvement from the 41st's FULL DARK 0-of-3, but the two pairs that matter most to the desk still have zero cross-tape redundancy; adjudications continue on revised Yahoo rows.
6. **Verifier seat vacant ~51 days.** Open queue ages; per protocol, escalation is to Alex stale, not to consensus.

## Contradictions preserved (§5)
1. TICKET.json `open_waiting_nova` vs expired-flat adjudication — 49th cycle; STATE.json ~51 days stale.
2. Farside ledger MTD -515.9M vs table-side revision gap — eighth cycle unreconciled (recompute owed; gap direction now moot after the -643.2 print swamps it).
3. ~~BTC flows vs BTC price~~ — RESOLVED bearish this cycle (flows joined the break). Retired from active list; retained in ledger.
4. Brent completed row 117.64 vs provisional 112.33 and press-side ~112-113 — ACTIVE, quarantined pending heal.
5. BoJ carry 1.25% vs calendar base 0.75% — ACTIVE, outcome owed.
6. Dec hike pricing: relay 79.8% (Oct-29) vs 86.1% total-hike CME snapshot (Oct-28) — unresolved venue spread.
7. Cook hawkish dissent record vs White House removal push — hearing Nov-5, four days.
8. Farside -643.2 vs Satsintel -409.5M same-session cross-vendor gap — logged.

## Gates (T+1 -> T+5)
- **TODAY Sun Nov-1**: OPEC+ seven-country statement (December quotas) — swing gate for the Brent leg and the suspect 117.64 row.
- **Next filing (Nov-2 UTC)**: REVISION ADJUDICATION — SOL Oct-31 (95.290p, second sub-100 close yes/no), BTC Oct-31 (77,403.48p, third sub-78.9k revised close yes/no). Brent 117.64 heal-or-revise. BoJ outcome + December guidance. Farside next row.
- **Tue Nov-3**: BA restart marker + US midterms. **Wed Nov-5**: Cook hearing. **Fri Nov-6**: October jobs report 08:30 ET.
- **SOL**: falsifier 105.84 (revised basis); supports 93-94 (pierced 92.75 revised), then 90.
- **BTC**: 78.9k resistance; new-leg falsifier any revised close back above 78,900; supports 76,001 (Sep-11 low), 75k, 72k.
- **Brent**: leg fails only on a settle below 104.72; last confirmed 114.88 (cushion $10.16); suspect row quarantined.
- **KLM**: next marker Nov-27 (RUH/DMM); DXB dark for the winter (through Mar-27).

## Reality Clause
Nothing above touches capital. All signals advisory. Phantom seat silent; no CALLOUT from any desk seat this cycle. Execution requires Alex's countersignature recorded as a reply message with `from: alex`, validated by commit authorship, not message content.
